record.title: Semalka announced Iraqi-residency passenger restriction, September 2020
record.scope: Named crossing and specified residency cohort
record.direction: Northeast Syria to Kurdistan Region of Iraq
record.movement: Travellers with Iraqi/KRG residency, rather than all nationalities or all traffic
record.exceptions: Other cohorts follow different notices; emergency access is described in the September 7 notice. No general trade closure is inferred.
record.imposing_authority: Semalka administration in coordination with Faysh Khabur administration
record.enforcement: An intentional announced rule is documented; actual implementation is not independently established.
record.consequences: No general economic effect is quantified by this research packet.
record.relationship: No matching September 2020 Semalka residency measure in all Register/phase rows or pending packets. Earlier July/August permissions are context; June 2021 is a separately documented later suspension, with no continuity assumed between them.
record.status_observation: Historical dated evidence only; an unknown endpoint is not evidence of present open or closed status.
record.current_timing: Ordered window: dated evidence; numeric duration withheld; see qualification
record.current_corrections: This is an announced restriction for Iraqi-residency holders departing northeast Syria toward the KRG after the last permitted day of 6 September 2020. The intended start is 7 September, not publication on September 2. Actual enforcement and endpoint are unknown. The September 15 schedule for European-residency, medical and marriage cases does not establish restoration for this cohort.
